subject: Civic Education
competence: Broad curriculum competency standard in plain English
lesson: Explains the diversity of world of work. Activity “Let’s undentify world of work” Time 40 minutes: Mock Local Council / Pradeshiya Sabha Session: Competency Level 8.6.1
unique_learning_outcome: Explains the diversity of world of work. Activity “Let’s undentify world of work” Time 40 minutes
the_entrance: 5-minute introduction: Imagine you are a new member of the Pradeshiya Sabha, a local council in Sri Lanka. Your role is to contribute to the decision-making process for the betterment of your community. What are some of the jobs and professions that you think are essential for the development of your community?

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Teacher introduces the Sri Lankan real-world scenario, clarifies group objectives, and distributes task cards and role assignments as a facilitator.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students arrange into collaborative groups, review inquiry task cards, assign group roles, and formulate investigative questions.
lesson_development_steps.learning_teaching_aids: Inquiry task cards, role sheets, scenario prompts

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Teacher actively circulates among student groups, facilitates inquiry, scaffolds complex civic concepts with probing questions, and ensures active participation.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students collaborate actively in assigned roles to execute the investigation/simulation, analyzing Sri Lankan community situations without passive spectators.
lesson_development_steps.learning_teaching_aids: Activity worksheets, observation sheets, chart paper, markers

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Teacher moderates student spokesperson presentations, facilitates constructive peer evaluation, and synthesizes key student findings against syllabus outcomes.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Group spokespersons present findings and solutions; peers evaluate presentations using criteria and note constructive feedback.
lesson_development_steps.learning_teaching_method: Spokesperson Presentation, Peer Review & Plenary Synthesis

summary: As a Pradeshiya Sabha member, you have identified the importance of various jobs and professions in your community. How do you think these jobs and professions contribute to the overall development of your community?
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Formative feedback criteria: Students' participation in the mock Pradeshiya Sabha session, their ability to identify and explain the diversity of the world of work, and their understanding of the importance of various jobs and professions in their community.
post_activity: 5-minute in-class assignment: Students reflect on their experience as Pradeshiya Sabha members and how it has helped them understand the diversity of the world of work and its importance in their community.
selected_activity:
Activity: Mock Local Council / Pradeshiya Sabha Session: Competency Level 8.6.1
Approach: Students use mock local council / pradeshiya sabha session to explore 'Explains the diversity of world of work. Activity “Let’s undentify world of work” Time 40 minutes'. Students take civic roles, respond to a shared scenario, and agree on a reasoned decision. Standard class layout (40 students): Desks arranged into 8 teams (8 teams (8 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Student task: Students take civic roles, respond to a shared scenario, and agree on a reasoned decision. Standard class layout (40 students): Desks arranged into 8 teams (8 teams (8 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Teacher facilitation: Organizes all 40 students using 8 teams (8 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer. and monitors progress with outcome-focused prompts and time checks. Circulates across 8 teams, facilitating role execution and formatively checking progress.
Expected output: A short role-based civic decision and its reasons.
Grouping: 8 teams (8 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer.
